Here are the visual differences between the original (IMAGE 1) and the clone (IMAGE 2):

1.  **Top-Right Language Badge:** The badge in IMAGE 1 displays **"SE"**, while the badge in IMAGE 2 displays **"DE"**.
2.  **Input Field Values (Content):**
    *   **Company Name:** IMAGE 1 contains "Acme Inc.", whereas IMAGE 2 contains "Demo Store Inc.".
    *   **Website:** IMAGE 1 contains "https://yoursite.com", whereas IMAGE 2 contains "https://demo-store.example.com".
    *   **Email:** IMAGE 1 contains "sepnetflix2023@outlook.com", whereas IMAGE 2 contains "demo@pixelco.local".
3.  **Bottom-Left Sidebar:**
    *   **Sign Out Text:** In IMAGE 1, the text reads "**Sign out**". In IMAGE 2, it is truncated or cut off, appearing as "**L...n out**".
    *   **Overlay Element:** IMAGE 2 has a dark circular overlay with the letter **"N"** appearing over the bottom-left corner (partially covering the progress bar and sign-out link), which is absent in IMAGE 1.
